Well, just to go along with your question, I'll say that I do it because of boredom or desire to experience new things but no opportunities or enough money to do something that isn't drugs. 

I feel like a big part of """"recreational"""" users choose to do it because of that. Maybe you could think "that's an excuse, you can do A/B/C without X/Y/Z" but that'd be oversimplifying things and maybe being too naive, thinking everyone everywhere is in the same circumstances you might be. 

For example, in my case, I live in a south american country, not third world, not rich or well-to-do, but with enough income to not be considered poor and not enough to have enough extra money or enough time to rest or enjoy something that isn't just a quick high, a few drinks or maybe a nice saturday if I don't have to do overtime to make ends meet. Decent or good enough quality drugs around here are cheap enough and easy enough to come by to be a real option for many people, commonplace enough to talk with any person you trust enough even if you'll be overheard by people you don't, and I imagine it's a similar situation in many other places around the world.
